title: ApexBrasil conecta inovação brasileira a ecossistemas globais com missões em Lisboa e Dubai (ABES)
what_it_says: ApexBrasil survey: over 13,000 startups, more than 120 investment funds, over 250 innovation hubs, over 30 unicorns; US$2.135 billion VC in 2024 across 386 deals; ApexBrasil supported nearly 100 startups at Web Summit Rio 2026.
